description: Issue #837 (maintainer ruling #833): the profile-INACTIVE half of the Interaction & Events binding pair. The same four bindings check clean under `core-language` alone, exactly as they do with the profile active (bindings-free-with-interaction, whose profile set differs from this one by exactly `interaction-events`). Binding a built-in name is free in every position and under every profile set: spec/grammar.md:386 makes it a normative MUST, spec/grammar.md:408 says what a profile decides is whether a name WORKS and never whether a program may declare it, and spec/grammar.md:388 explains why enforcement sits at the four declaration slots instead. Either fixture alone would also be satisfied by an implementation that never restricted these names at all; only the pair, read with block-heads-reserved-under-profile / block-heads-free-core-only, separates binding from declaration. `"check": true` -- nothing is executed and no events are produced.
